'''Londrod''' was an [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]] bike vendor who was stationed outside of [[Mos Ila]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], just outside of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] settlement there.
